coverage: Full archive SHA/length and decoded SHA/length with exclusive private destination
Atomic no-replace restoration receipt after decoded file/parent fsync
Historical ledger/receipt hashes unchanged; new identity admitted through explicit custody proof
Interrupted decode, crash before receipt, failed fsync and partial output reject admission/retry
Wrong archive, decoded SHA mismatch, changed history/config/data, symlink/existing file and low space/pressure refuse
Retained archive allocation included in resume budget
tests.scope: SMALL synthetic owned file fixtures only; mocked host/idle admission. No real stage restore, HFS mount or node integration proof.

allocation_evidence.measurement: lstat file blocks; no symlink traversal (negative fixtures intentionally contain symlinks)

admission_api: cold_restore.verify_restored called by chipnet_resume.resume_plan when restoration claim/receipt exists
durability: Exclusive fsynced claim before target creation; decoded file+parent fsynced; complete private new receipt fsynced then atomically hard-linked under final exclusive name and parent fsynced. Interrupted temporary links/partial files require manual review; no cleanup/retry.
safeguards: Historical fixed-store/exit/custody records never edited. New receipt binds original record hashes, archive hash/length, decoded hash/length, old/new identity, empty diagnostic config, and claim hash. No mount/launch step exists in restore function.
entry_gates: Fresh passed sustained>=60s normal-pressure/stable-swap/no-build report plus current free >= decoded length +12GiB +64MiB headroom. Rechecked while decoding. Existing/partial target or claim denies repeat. Full sync still>=25GiB or assigned storage AND root review.
host_cleanup_status: OX cleanup reported approved/underway, receipt pending; no gain or new quiet window assumed. No new actual resource probe performed.
